posts.query:
SELECT M.mukey, M.musym, M.muname, A.drclassdcd, A.flodfreqdcd, A.hydclprs, L.areasymbol, L.areaname, S.saverest
FROM mapunit M LEFT JOIN muaggatt A ON A.mukey = M.mukey JOIN legend L ON L.lkey = M.lkey LEFT JOIN sacatalog S ON S.areasymbol = L.areasymbol
WHERE M.mukey IN (SELECT * FROM SDA_Get_Mukey_from_intersection_with_WktWgs84('point(-65.960000 18.447000)'))

Table: Humacao Area, Puerto Rico Eastern Part

posts.query:
SELECT P.mukey, M.musym, M.muname, A.drclassdcd, A.flodfreqdcd, A.hydclprs, L.areasymbol, L.areaname, S.saverest, P.mupolygongeo.STIntersection(geometry::STGeomFromText('POLYGON((-65.9598595 18.4470493, -65.9599400 18.4467930, -65.9602412 18.4468373, -65.9601674 18.4471220, -65.9598595 18.4470493))', 4326).MakeValid().STBuffer(0.0002)).STAsText() AS wkt
FROM mupolygon P JOIN mapunit M ON M.mukey = P.mukey LEFT JOIN muaggatt A ON A.mukey = P.mukey JOIN legend L ON L.lkey = M.lkey LEFT JOIN sacatalog S ON S.areasymbol = L.areasymbol
WHERE P.mupolygongeo.STIntersects(geometry::STGeomFromText('POLYGON((-65.9598595 18.4470493, -65.9599400 18.4467930, -65.9602412 18.4468373, -65.9601674 18.4471220, -65.9598595 18.4470493))', 4326).MakeValid()) = 1

Table: Humacao Area, Puerto Rico Eastern Part
